scaling.setup: closed-form limits of a 30 g x +/-3.5 mm reaction mass, a CMG pair with H 1.2 mN m s, reaction wheels (MFR motors), a propeller, a passive rotor; Rev H linear hand-pen receptances at r_rot 0.3/0.5/0.7
scaling.findings: At 3 Hz: reaction mass 26 mN; CMG pair 45 mN m; wheel (2214 BXT rated) 8.9 mN m. Propeller: 27 mN per 22 mm fan at 0.5 W. Passive rotor 3 mN m s: gyroscopic stiffening H w / K_rot = 5 % at 8 Hz (r_rot 0.5).
scaling.implication: Moving the ink 2 mm at 3 Hz needs about 0.54 N at the end-cap or 148 mN m (r_rot 0.5, relaxed hand, no paper friction); a 30 g x +/-3.5 mm mass gives 26 mN and a CMG pair 45 mN m. A mass's force falls as f^2; a CMG's torque falls as f below its angle-limited corner.
scaling.relevance: Sets what any end-cap device can do at writing (1-5 Hz) and tremor (4-12 Hz) frequencies
scaling.limitations: Closed-form single-frequency limits; linear model with the relaxed HAP-26 hand and no paper friction

optimise.setup: CMA-ES (derivative-free, discrete motor and arrangement choices) and autograd (Adam through a differentiable linear model) for 4 device classes and mass caps 15-45 g; 26 x 45 mm, 1 W peak, 0.3 W average
optimise.findings: 45 g tremor optima (linear bound, 4-12 Hz, 1 mm, mean of 3 splits): reaction mass 0.35 (30 g moving, +/-4.0 mm, 0.14 W); CMG DG1 0.03 (H 2.04 mN m s at 27987 rpm, 0.20 W, stored 3.0 J); steering at 3 Hz: reaction mass 0.131 mm, CMG 0.56 mm (weakest direction).
optimise.units: ratio of handle-tip tremor with/without; mm
optimise.implication: At 45 g the CMG has the lower linear tremor bound (the best any controller could do within the device limits). Reaction wheels: bound 1.05 (infeasible). Passive rotor: bound 1.03 (1 = no change).
optimise.relevance: Chooses the end-cap design in each device class and the arrangement of the CMG
optimise.limitations: Linear bounds with ideal knowledge of the tremor; part masses partly ASSUMPTION; the integrated hub motor is a concept

recommendation.setup: rule R-D1 applied to the test results
recommendation.relevance: Which end-cap to carry into the Rev J architecture
recommendation.limitations: Rests on the simulations above; nothing measured
